authority_scope: Only these three private source sites; no public-helper or generic Result/error/body/signedvalid/GossipControl release

sites.policy_verdict: Defensible bounded receive/framing policy, conditional on origin and composition controls; not adopted.
sites.true_means: The type-3/type-4 control passes the existing bounded framing/canonical decoding checks. This is not expiration acceptance, invitation ownership, group-key-package signature validity, or an accepted message request.
sites.false_means: Any framing/decoding error or false validation is collapsed to ignored control, as before.
sites.authority: Private helper reached only from the two actual successful receive paths after kind, peer/conversation/recipient, and blocked checks; future composed VO/auth guards must also precede entry.
sites.effects: True permits load_invitations (including expiry filtering, removal labels, pruning serialization/seal/store), followed by the separate receive-control current_time. False returns empty writes with no invitation loader/prune/clock/context/final seal.
sites.disclosure: Bounded framing acceptance of the authenticated private control to observers of invitation storage/pruning/time work; not a global public parser predicate.
sites.policy_caveat: Type-4 canonical decoding includes checkpoint and package structure but does not verify the package signature. A well-framed expired, duplicate, full-list, or otherwise ignored invitation may still reach loading/pruning and the final no-op-list seal.
sites.reason: private initial or ratchet receive after peer identity conversation recipient and block checks releases only bounded invitation framing acceptance before invitation storage access and pruning; body fields and parser errors remain private

sites.policy_verdict: HELD policy exception: defensible only if this exact pre-ownership membership/access disclosure is explicitly accepted. Reject any owner-only/authenticated-acceptance characterization.
sites.predicate: Preparation is Ok(InvitationAcceptance(...)) and the selected previous.state == 3; preparation error => false.
sites.true_means: The first loaded record matching id || inner.sender_device_id exists and is state 3. The subsequent ownership/group/package comparisons have NOT run.
sites.false_means: Invitation rather than acceptance, missing reference, other state, or preparation failure; false does not distinguish them.
sites.authority: Authenticated unblocked peer origin, not invitation-owner authority. Reference lookup binds recipient_device only; account ownership is tested later.
sites.effects: True calls load_transparency_view at the original point: manifest, three chunk reads on successful manifest path, checkpoint, native configuration, and conditional witnesses/time; failures short-circuit before later ownership comparisons and serialization.
sites.disclosure: An adaptive selected-reference membership/state predicate plus invocation of the existing transparency-view access trace and its failure behavior. The invitation ID and sender device select the predicate even though no raw identifier is declassified.
sites.policy_caveat: Device ID is not an account-global proof. Even a legitimate authenticated sender can supply wrong group/package ownership data and still trigger the view read. A different account with an equal device ID is not rejected by find_invitation before this site. Moving ownership checks earlier or loading unconditionally changes access/error/effect order and is not an authorized drop-in fix.
sites.reason: private authenticated invitation receive releases only whether successful control preparation found an existing state3 acceptance requiring the current transparency view; reference membership is exposed only through this decision and identifiers key packages and later authorization decisions remain private
sites.status: scratch policy review only; no approved inventory entry

sites.policy_verdict: Defensible bounded readiness-for-final-seal policy, conditional on actual compiler shape/payload separation and runtime order; not adopted.
sites.predicate: Result.is_ok(encoded), where encoded preserves prepare/finish/serialization Result without releasing its payload.
sites.true_means: Pure preparation, pure completion using any required view, and the original bounded serialization succeeded. Ignored/no-op controls also return true.
sites.false_means: A preparation/completion/encoding error occurred; exact error class and payload are not part of the Bool.
sites.authority: The same private receive path and the exact immutable prepared/encoded value; public caller-built continuations are not evidence.
sites.effects: False returns the original private error without final local_context or invitation seal. True constructs constant-label local_context and attempts exactly one final invitation seal; earlier caller and pruning seals are outside this count.
sites.disclosure: One composite serialization/preparation readiness fact, not whether ownership comparisons accepted or state changed. Existing codec framing disclosures and seal-discriminant behavior remain dependencies.
sites.policy_caveat: The Err payload remains private; returning Err(error) must not accidentally make it public or erase the caller PC. Unknown primitive errors must retain their exact value. The empty unwrap_or fallback is unreachable on errors at source level; verify on the actual compiler/runtime.
sites.reason: private authenticated invitation receive releases only successful pure control completion and invitation encoding before context construction and one local seal; exact failure payloads and encoded invitation records remain private and failed preparation performs no context construction or seal
